auth.meta_descricao: Ngena noma uzibhalise ukuze ulandelele idatha yakho nemikhuba yakho ku-Carbono Consciente.
auth.esquerda_texto: Ngena ukuze ulandelele idatha yakho, imikhuba yakho nomkhondo wakho wekhabhoni.

inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: imfundo yemvelo ngokukhishwa kwekhabhoni, umkhondo wekhabhoni, amathiphu asimeme, izinto ezithakazelisayo kanye nezindaba zemvelo.

hero.titulo: Umkhuba omncane ngamunye uthwalisa iplanethi umthwalo omncane
hero.texto: ICARBONO CONSCIENTE AYISIPHAWU OLUHLAZA NOMA UMGOMO OKUDE — IYISAMBA SOKUKHETHA OKUVAMILE, OKUPHINDWAYO NSUKU ZONKE: OKU UKUTSHALA, INDLELA OHAMBA NGAYO, UKUTHI UCIMA UKUKHANYA NINI, UKUTHI UPHONSA UDOTI KUPHI.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni kukukhishwa kwamagesi afana neCO₂ emkhathini, ngokuvamile ngokushiswa kwezinsalela zofosili, ukugawulwa kwamahlathi, ukukhiqizwa kwezimboni ngisho nokuthutha kwansuku zonke.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Amagesi aholela esisilingweni akha uxaxa olubamba ukushisa emkhathini. Uma ukukhishwa kwanda, lo mphumela nawo wanda — futhi yilokhu okuholela ekushiseni komhlaba nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Yisamba sonke samagesi aholela esisilingweni avelayo, ngqo noma ngokungaqondile, ngemisebenzi yomuntu, inkampani noma umkhiqizo kunsuku zonke.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Ikhabhoni engathathi hlangothi ifuna ukulinganisa noma ukukhokhela ukukhishwa okuvelayo. Carbono consciente ibeka phambili ukukhetha okunciphisa umthelela emvelweni ngaphambi kokucabanga ngokukhokhela.

fatos.fato1: Isihlahla esidala simunca cishe amakhilogremu angu-22 we-CO₂ ngonyaka — yingakho ukutshalwa kabusha kwamahlathi kuyindlela eqondile yokulungisa ukukhutshwa kwemigqomo.
fatos.fato2: Olwandle lumunca cishe ikota yawo wonke umoya we-CO₂ okhutshwa yisintu minyaka yonke, lusebenza njengesilungiselela esikhulu sesimo sezulu somhlaba.
fatos.fato3: Ukuphinda ukusetshenziswa kwethoni eyodwa yephepha kongeleza izihlahla ezingaba ngu-17 kanye nenani elikhulu lamanzi namandla uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhiqiza iphepha elisha.
fatos.fato4: Ukuthuthwa kunesibopho sekota yokukhutshwa komoya we-CO₂ emhlabeni jikelele ehlobene namandla — ukushintsha imoto ibhayisikili noma izokuthutha zomphakathi ohambweni olufushane kwenza umehluko wangempela.
fatos.fato5: I-Amazon ikhaya lezinhlobonhlobo zokuphila ezingaba ngu-10% zazo zonke ezaziwayo emhlabeni, futhi igcina izigidigidi zethoni zekhabhoni ezitshalweni zayo.
fatos.fato6: Amaphaneli elanga asendlini angehlisa izinyathelo zekhabhoni zendlu ngamathoni e-CO₂ ngonyaka, kuncike kumxube wamandla endawo.
fatos.fato7: Ukudla okunenyama ebomvu encane kungancishisa kakhulu izinyathelo zekhabhoni zomuntu, ngoba ukufuya izinkomo kuyingxenye yomsebenzi wokulima okhipha imigqomo eminingi.
fatos.fato8: Ukuncibilika kweqhwa lolwandle e-Arctic kwehlisa amandla omhlaba okubuyisela ukukhanya kwelanga esikhaleni, okusheshisa ukushisa — umphumela owaziwa ngokubuyela kwe-albedo.
fatos.fato9: Izibani ze-LED zisebenzisa amandla ancishisiwe ngamaphesenti engaba ngu-80 kunezibani zendabuko, futhi zihlala isikhathi eside kakhulu, zincishisa kokubili ukukhishwa kwemigqomo nemfucuza.
fatos.fato10: Isivumelwano saseParis, esisayinwe amazwe acishe abe ngu-200, sihlose ukunciphisa ukufuduma komhlaba ukuba kube ngaphansi kuka-2°C ngaphezu kwezinga langaphambi kwemboni.
fatos.fato11: Cishe ingxenye yesithathu yalo lonke ukudla okukhiqizwa emhlabeni kuchithwa — lokhu kuchitha kodwa kukhiqiza ingxenye enkulu yokukhutshwa komoya womhlaba wezingxenye zokushisa.
fatos.fato12: Amathobhini omoya ahlobo lwanamuhla angakhiqiza amandla anele ukunika amakhaya ayizinkulungwane, ngaphandle kokukhipha i-CO₂ ngesikhathi sokusebenza.
fatos.fato13: Umhlabathi onempilo ugcina ikhabhoni eningi kunazo zonke izitshalo nomkhathi kuhlanganisiwe — izinqubo zokulima ezivuselela zisiza ukugcina leyo khabhoni phansi.
fatos.fato14: Izintaba zamakorali, nakuba zisibekela ngaphansi kuka-1% yesisekelo solwandle, zisekela cishe u-25% wayo yonke impilo yolwandle eyaziwayo — futhi zinzwayo kakhulu kokufudumala kwamanzi.
fatos.fato15: Ukunciphisa ukumoshwa kwamanzi ashisayo ekhaya (isibonelo, ukugeza ngesikhathi esifushane) nakho kuncishisa ukukhishwa kwemigqomo, ngoba ukufudumeza amanzi kusebenzisa amandla.
fatos.fato16: Izimoto zogesi, ngisho noma kubhekwa ukukhiqizwa kwebhethri, zivame ukukhipha i-CO₂ encane ngesikhathi sayo sonke sokusebenza kunezimoto zokushisa, ikakhulukazi lapho ugesi uvela emithombo emsulwa.
fatos.fato17: Ukwenza umquba wemfucuza yemvelo ekhaya kuvimbela ukuba ikhiqize igesi yemethane endaweni yokulahla izibi — igesi yesimo sezulu enamandla ngaphezu kwe-CO₂ esikhathini esifushane.
fatos.fato18: Amankqwazi aseGreenland nase-Antarctica ndawonye alahlekelwa amakhulu ezigidigidi zethoni zeqhwa ngonyaka eminyakeni yamuva, okufaka isandla ngqo ekukhukhumaleni kwamazinga olwandle.

globo.sem_dados_territorio: Ayikho idatha yokukhishwa kweCO₂ ngomuntu ngamunye etholakala kulesi sifunda.
globo.fonte_estimativa: Isilinganiso seCO₂ yofosili ngomuntu ngamunye (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, unyaka wesisekelo 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: Umhlaba osebenzisanayo wokukhishwa kwekhabhoni. Hudula ukuzungeza, skrolisha ukusondeza, chofoza izwe ukubona idatha, futhi uchofoze kabili ukubeka umhlaba esimweni sokugqamisa.
globo.aria_decorativo: Umhlaba wokuhlobisa ozungezayo, obonisa ukufinyelela komhlaba kwiphrojekthi yeCarbono Consciente.
